messages:
maria: Heads-up — sim shows EU-edge NL cluster hits 92% GPU util during the promo weekend if we keep current routing. tokens/sec spike is localized to nl-region.
jonathan: ugh. do we have delta numbers?
kai: is this with caching still enabled?
maria: yes. replayed last 24h traffic scaled +2.5x for the promo. peak aggregate ~1.6M tokens/s across 48 GPUs vs baseline 0.9M. avg seq len +1.8x.
sophie: egress limits on eu-west1 may also kick in (10Gb/s). that could create backpressure separate from gpu.
infra-bot: [SIM] run_id=sim-2026-03-17-07 status=done peak_tokens_s=1603120 peak_gpu_util=92%
jonathan: any quick mitigations? route some traffic to dedicated pools?
maria: ran an offload simulation to dedicated pool (same region reserved). result: gpu util drops to 68%, tokens/s to 1.1M, p95 latency 280ms. warmup overhead estimated.
kai: warmup waste concerns — previous offloads added ~10% warmup waste for short-lived requests.
maria: measured warmup loss ~8% GPU time in that sim. projected cost delta still < cost of errors/egress throttles.
sophie: ops proposal — enable a temporary redispatch policy: offload up to 40% when cluster util >85%, with cross-region latency limit 150ms. Canary for 6h during the promo window.
maria: infra-bot dry-run applied policy for 30s earlier. infra-bot: [DRY-RUN] redispatch policy "offload_on_saturation" simulated on nl-cluster, offload_pct=30 -> success
jonathan: can we avoid cross-region cold-start spikes? if we bounce many short requests we'll waste more tokens.
maria: we should prefer offloading long-context sessions first. policy can prioritize by cache-hit ratio and session length.
sophie: I'll draft the deploy ticket. also want metric alerts: redispatch_fail_rate, warmup_waste_pct, cross_region_p95_ms. thresholds?
jonathan: set redispatch_fail_rate alert >1% sustained 5m, warmup_waste_pct >5% sustained 10m, cross_region_p95_ms >150ms 3m
maria: posting config snippet to test in canary: 
```
redispatch:
  policy: offload_on_saturation
  threshold_gpu_util: 85
  max_offload_pct: 40
  prioritize_by: [cache_hit_ratio, session_len]
  cross_region_latency_limit_ms: 150
```
emma: finance: quick calc — for a 6h canary using reserved burst: incremental cost ~ $12k. if we rely on spot fallbacks with cross-region routing it's ~ $21k due to extra warmup and egress.
sophie: ops prefers reserved small-burst for canary + alerts. I'll open ticket and tag sec for egress implications.
maria: will update runbook and add rollback steps if redispatch_fail_rate spikes.
jonathan: schedule canary for Fri 00:00-06:00 UTC, and add post-canary retrospective in #eng-infra.
kai: pinging @emma for finance approval, and @sec-team for egress checks.
emma: finance approves reserved burst for canary. verify cost model after run.
sophie: opening deploy ticket now: infra/tickets/4378 — enabling redispatch canary, linking sim artifacts.
maria: thanks — will follow during the window and post logs. :thumbsup:
jonathan: thanks team, keep updates in this thread.
